independent_case.title: Apply a new case independently
independent_case.task: Text C permits internal reading only; D permits public quotation up to 30 words with attribution. Proposed public handout reproduces 40 words. Apply the fictional terms.
independent_case.answer: Teacher explanation: C lacks public-use permission; 40 exceeds D limit. Revise D quotation to at most 30 words with attribution or obtain permission. Do not infer legal exceptions from this fictional policy.
independent_case.source: primary source W4, first curriculum occurrence

misconceptions: The worked result establishes every future case
Real legal outcomes depend on jurisdiction and facts; supplied licence terms define this classroom exercise, not universal copyright law.
A missing input may be replaced without recording the change
A replacement changes the evidence or contract. Record the change and its justification; do not silently turn unknown into a measured value.
Repeating an assessed case is new independent evidence
A replay checks consistency. An example used for feedback or revision cannot later be described as untouched final evaluation.

blocks.text: A closer explanation

For this fictional policy, licence L permits classroom display with attribution but forbids public redistribution. Licence M permits adaptation and redistribution with attribution. Unknown permission means seek approval or choose a permitted alternative; this exercise is not a legal ruling.
